# Test pe version control - Git-like functionality for prompts
# TODO: Full version control not yet implemented

# Initialize repository
exec pe init
stdout 'Initialized PE repository'
exists .pe

# Basic mod commands for module management
exec pe mod init example/mymodule
stdout 'Created go.mod'
exists go.mod
exec grep 'module example/mymodule' go.mod

# Edit mod file
exec pe edit --module example/dependency@v1.0.0
stdout 'Added requirement: example/dependency v1.0.0'
exec grep 'example/dependency v1.0.0' go.mod

# Work with modules
exec pe work init
stdout 'Created go.work'
exists go.work
exec grep 'go 1.21' go.work

# Basic attestation for tracking changes
exec pe attest init
stdout 'Attestation store initialized'
exists .pe/attestations/config.json
